payload.summary: The incident involves a brute force attack on the account jdoe, but the successful login occurred after a documented change involving a password reset. This suggests that the successful login may be a result of the password reset rather than an attack.

attack_chain.description: Brute force attack on the account jdoe from the source IP 10.80.0.15.

risk_factors: Brute force attack on an account
Successful login after a password reset
